note: Defects found by the automated QA suite (tests/qa). One entry per defect; 'cases' are the TC IDs whose check shows it. Status: Open (deferred) — not fixed in this round, with the reason; Open (owner decision) — needs a business decision first; Fixed (re-test pending) — fixed and covered by unit / integration tests, the site run still to confirm; Fixed in part; Fixed - retest passed (with fixedIn and retest); Not changed (by design); Not a defect.

defects.title: Write APIs read the request before checking the session
defects.actual: 19 write routes (15 handlers) answered a signed-out caller 404 NOT_FOUND or 422 VALIDATION_FAILED instead of 401: they validated the body or looked the record up first, so a guest learnt field names and whether an id exists. Nothing could be changed signed out.
defects.expected: 401 for every write API called without a session (TC-SEC-001); guards first (src/server/authz/guards.ts: 'Every mutating route handler and server action begins with one of these').
defects.fix: requireUser() as the first statement of the 15 handlers (orders status/fulfilment/assign/fulfilment-plan, shop-products, excel-uploads, invoices einvoice/eway-bill, products, price-requests, marketing segments, admin payout batches).
defects.retest: 2026-10-24 gokesari.com guest tier after release #242 (df923a2): TC-SEC-001, TC-RBAC-002 pass (docs/testing/qa-runs/2026-10-24-production-release-3.json)

defects.title: A malformed id in the URL answers 500
defects.actual: GET /api/shops/abc/products (and other id routes, e.g. PATCH /api/cart/items/undefined) → 500 INTERNAL: PostgreSQL 'invalid input syntax for type uuid' reached the generic error handler.

defects.fix: toClientError() maps PostgreSQL 22P02 for type uuid to 404 NOT_FOUND (src/lib/errors.ts); unit test tests/unit/errors-invalid-id.test.ts.

defects.title: A rewarded referral found fraudulent cannot be reversed
defects.actual: A REWARDED referral cannot be flagged and there is no reversal mechanism.
defects.expected: A fraudulent rewarded referral is reversed with a ledger entry.
defects.fix: Owner decision 25 Oct: yes. Admin → Customer referrals → 'Reverse reward' (WALLET_ADJUST, reason required) takes both rewards back as wallet REVERSAL entries pointing at the original credit (reversal_of_id), never below zero (the shortfall is recorded), marks the referral REVERSED, tells both customers and audits it; the friend's mobile can't earn again (migration 0093). Not done: TC-MKT-017 also expects risk flags raised for the pair; the reversal is a manual admin action.

defects.title: Two simultaneous 'add to cart' of the same product: one answers 500 (new line) or one add is lost (existing line)
defects.actual: POST /api/cart is fine one request at a time (Burger Bun and Bread, quantity 1 and 2, on an empty cart and onto an existing line: all 200, GET /api/cart 200 before and after). Two POSTs of the same product at the same moment on an empty cart: one 200, the other 500 {"error":{"code":"INTERNAL","message":"Something went wrong. Please try again."}} — 5 of 5 rounds on the staging customer2 account; the cart then holds one line ×2, so the failing request wrote nothing (the failure is in the add's insert, not in the cart read after it). Two POSTs of different products at once: both 200. Two POSTs of the same product at once when the line already exists: both 200 but 1 + 2 + 2 is saved as 3, not 5 (2 of 2 rounds) — a silent lost update. Four simultaneous GET /api/cart: all 200. First seen 15:21:59 UTC when another session used the same staging customer (TC-LIST-021 set-up; that session placed order DB-20261024-ITRVQT at 15:22:54 UTC). Cause: addToCart (src/server/services/cart.ts) reads the line and then inserts or updates it outside a transaction — the second insert hits the unique index cart_items_cart_product_unique (unhandled → 500), and two updates both write existing + quantity from the same read. Evidence: scratchpad qa2/cart-500-isolation.log and qa2/cart-race.log.
defects.expected: A double tap or two tabs never produce a 500 and never lose units: both adds succeed with the line holding the sum (within stock and the 99 cap), or one is refused with a clear message; the saved quantity matches what the answers report.
defects.fix: src/server/services/cart.ts: addToCart and setCartItemQuantity run in one transaction that first locks the customer's cart row (lockCart: select … for update on carts), so two changes at the same moment run one after the other and the second reads what the first wrote — no second insert into cart_items_cart_product_unique, no add written from a stale read. sendPurchaseListToCart (src/server/services/purchase-lists.ts) takes the same lock, so a list sent while the same product is added, or two lists sent at once, cannot clash either.
